name: North (Account API Key Required)
description: North • Nordic & Danish Cloudstream Extension (by sealinwater). ⚠️ ACCOUNT API KEY REQUIRED: You need a NordicBytes account and UNIT3D API key to use North. Apply at https://nordicbytes.org/application (your application text is public so members can vouch for you, so don't include your real name or personal info; your email and 2 tracker proof screenshot/profile links are only visible to staff), then copy your API key from Profile -> Settings -> API Key into North Settings.
